name: campus-web
description: Cloudflare Worker runtime shell for the student-facing campus experience surface.

scripts.build: node ./scripts/build-published-reader-docs.mjs && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite build && node ../../scripts/check_web_client_bundle_budget.mjs --app apps/campus-web
scripts.build:staging: node ./scripts/build-published-reader-docs.mjs --staging && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home node ../../scripts/run-worker-staging-build.mjs -- vite build && node ../../scripts/check_web_client_bundle_budget.mjs --app apps/campus-web
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && node ../../scripts/verify-worker-deploy-config.mjs dist/campus_web/wrangler.json APP_API=app-api && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --config dist/campus_web/wrangler.json
scripts.preview: pnpm build && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite preview
